title: 第10章 柳嫣然

content_zh:
不是因为结识了楚海山和魏青衫两个大人物而兴奋，而是想着，怎么对付那个黄三太奶…
“修炼千年的黄皮子精，最起码也要三位术法大师联手才能灭杀，我的法力，明显还不够格。”
宁小凡很是苦恼。
根据青乌风水篇里的记载，这黄皮子害人，是祸及四代，所以他怀疑，这段恩怨恐怕要追溯到楚惜颜曾爷爷，甚至高祖那一辈。
他本想向灵儿讨教，哪想掏出手机连发好几条消息，这小丫头都不理他。
宁小凡郁闷地哗啦啦——
长长的指针飞速转动。
“上帝耶稣如来老儿，给我来件法宝神器什么的，仙丹也行！”
宁小凡嘿嘿地笑着，只听“叮”的一声脆响，指针停下。
“恭喜宿主，你抽到了一颗【过期的天人丹】，已存入百宝囊，可提取使用。”
“丹药？还尼玛是过期的？”
宁小凡一脸郁闷，点开百宝囊。
【过期的天人丹】：
一品仙丹，采集最为精纯的天地灵气炼制而成，使用后，脑域开发度将达到20%，拥有近乎妖孽的智商！
（注：由于丹药存放太久，已经过期三百年，所以某些方面的功效已丧失。）
“坑爹淘宝店！”宁小凡气得咒骂一句。
随后，一道白光闪现，一颗龙眼大小的丹药静静躺立，周身泛着乳白色光泽，圆润精致，跟旺仔牛仔糖的造型挺雷同。
“虽然是一品丹药，但好歹也算仙丹，可不能浪费了……”
宁小凡将天人丹丢进嘴里，略微嚼动，“大脑开发度达到20%，我滴个乖乖，貌似爱因斯坦才10%吧？哈哈，小爷这是要逆天啊！”
正兴奋地想着，忽然一阵剧烈的撕裂感从脑中涌起，疼得他“咕咚！”一声掉下床。

“，啊啊啊！”
“坑爹的三无产品！”
闷热的周末。
一辆即将发动的公交车上，宁小凡靠窗而坐，手里捧着一本书，正在如饥似渴的学习着。
自从大脑接受天人丹的洗礼后，他发现自己的学习能力，达到了一个近乎妖孽的程度。
一天可以熟背数千英文单词！
压轴级的数学大题，在他眼中就跟“1+1=2”没啥区别！
十分钟内解决一张省级比赛的理综试卷，而且是满分！
有了这样恐怖的学习能力，什么天华、燕大、福旦，还不是任由他挑？
花了几天功夫，把高三各科所有重点难点复习了个通透后，宁小凡开始转战其他领域，例如建筑、金融、文学、音乐、互联网……
“不好意思，我可以坐在这里吗？”
一道悦耳的声音在耳畔响起。
宁小凡抬起头，瞬间愣住了，眼前是一张白俏的漂亮脸蛋。
这是一个很美很美的女人，身高大概一米七，柳叶细眉上架着一副金丝眼镜，乌黑的秀发垂落肩头，英气中透着冷艳，性感而又迷人。
她仅仅站在那里，就给人一种凤凰飞落鹅棚的感觉，所有人都呆滞了，司机师傅也忘了发车。
柳嫣然显然见多不怪，她蹙起秀眉，在闷热的公交车内环视一圈，还是没找到空位，只有宁小凡身旁还可以挤一挤。
“请问，我可以坐在这里吗？”
“当然可以。”
宁小凡将书本合上，笑着给柳嫣然挤出一个狭窄的位置。
柳嫣然有些尴尬，这个位置实在太小了，如果强行挤坐下去，肯定会和宁小凡来个亲密接触。但如果不坐，就意味着要站两个多小时……

‘算了，就给这小子占点便宜吧。’
柳嫣然咬了咬牙，对宁小凡说了声谢谢后，挨着他的身体挤坐了下去。
和一个陌生男人挨在一起，让柳嫣然心里泛起一点难言的尴尬。
她如此最尊贵的身份，什么时候受过这种待遇？
“这个不靠谱的小兰！说好一点来接我，现在两点了还没人影，回去我一定要炒她鱿鱼！”柳嫣然银牙紧咬。
车子摇摇晃晃地启动。
两人不时触碰，柳嫣然羞愤之余，也庆幸今天自己没穿短裤，否则这漫漫长途，还真不知道怎么熬……
车子里相当闷热。
四周至少有七八双眼睛，虎视眈眈地盯着自己，柳嫣然很害怕下一刻这些男人会扑上来，把她给生吞活剥了。
倒是紧挨着自己的少年，一直在低头看书，没有丝毫过分的举动。
这让柳嫣然很诧异，难道他对自己不感兴趣？

content_en:
Not because I was excited about getting to know Chu Haishan and Wei Qingshan, but because I was thinking about how to deal with that Mrs. Huang...
"It takes at least three magic masters to join forces to kill the yellow-skinned demon who has been practicing for thousands of years. My magic power is obviously not up to the mark."
Ning Xiaofan was very distressed.
According to the records in the Qingwu Feng Shui chapter, the yellow skin caused harm to people and affected four generations, so he suspected that this grudge could be traced back to Chu Xiyan's great grandfather, or even the great ancestor.
He originally wanted to ask Ling'er for advice, but he didn't want to take out his phone and send several messages in succession. The little girl ignored him.
Ning Xiaofan burst into tears in frustration——
The long pointer rotates rapidly.
"God, Jesus, Tathagata, old man, please give me a magic weapon, artifact, or something like an elixir!"
Ning Xiaofan chuckled and heard a crisp "ding" sound, and the pointer stopped.
"Congratulations to the host, you have drawn an [Expired Heavenly Man Pill], which has been stored in the treasure bag and can be withdrawn for use."
"Elixir? Isn't it expired?"
Ning Xiaofan looked depressed and opened the treasure bag.
[Expired Heavenly Man Pill]:
A first-grade elixir is refined by collecting the purest spiritual energy from heaven and earth. After use, the brain development rate will reach 20%, and it will have an IQ that is almost evil!
(Note: Because the elixir has been stored for too long and has expired for three hundred years, some aspects of its efficacy have been lost.)
"Cheating Taobao store!" Ning Xiaofan cursed angrily.
Then, a white light flashed, and a longan-sized elixir lay quietly, with a milky white luster all over its body. It was round and delicate, very similar to the shape of Wangzai cowboy candy.
"Although it is a first-grade elixir, it is still considered an elixir, so it cannot be wasted..."
Ning Xiaofan threw the Heavenly Man Pill into his mouth and chewed it a little, "The brain development level has reached 20%. I'm a good boy. It seems that Einstein is only 10%, right? Haha, I'm going to defy the heavens!"
While he was thinking excitedly, a violent tearing feeling suddenly surged from his mind, causing him to fall off the bed with a "Glunk!"
", ah ah ah!"
"This is a scam product!"
Sultry weekend.
On a bus that was about to start, Ning Xiaofan was sitting by the window, holding a book in his hand and studying eagerly.
After his brain was baptized by the Heavenly Man Pill, he found that his learning ability had reached an almost monster level.
You can memorize thousands of English words in one day!
The final math question is no different from "1+1=2" in his eyes!
Solve a comprehensive science test paper for a provincial competition in ten minutes, and get full marks!
With such a terrifying learning ability, why should Tianhua, Yanda, and Fudan not be chosen by him?
After spending a few days reviewing all the key and difficult subjects in senior high school, Ning Xiaofan began to move to other fields, such as architecture, finance, literature, music, the Internet...
"Excuse me, can I sit here?"
A pleasant voice sounded in my ears.
Ning Xiaofan raised his head and was stunned for a moment. In front of him was a fair and pretty face.
This is a very beautiful woman, about 1.7 meters tall, with a pair of gold-rimmed glasses on her slender eyebrows, her black hair hanging down her shoulders, her heroic demeanor is cool, sexy and charming.
She just stood there, giving people the feeling of a phoenix flying down the goose coop. Everyone was stunned, and the driver also forgot to start the train.
Liu Yanran was obviously not surprised. She frowned and looked around in the hot and stuffy bus, but still couldn't find an empty seat. Only Ning Xiaofan could squeeze in.
"Excuse me, can I sit here?"
"Of course."
Ning Xiaofan closed the book and squeezed a narrow spot for Liu Yanran with a smile.
Liu Yanran was a little embarrassed. This seat was too small. If she forced herself to sit down, she would definitely have close contact with Ning Xiaofan. But if you don’t sit, it means standing for more than two hours...‘Forget it, let’s give this guy some advantage. ’
Liu Yanran gritted her teeth, said thank you to Ning Xiaofan, and sat down next to his body.
Being next to a strange man made Liu Yanran feel a little embarrassed.
With such a noble status, when had she ever received such treatment?
"This unreliable Xiaolan! You promised to pick me up earlier, but now it's two o'clock and there's no one around. I'll fire her when we get back!" Liu Yanran gritted her teeth.
The car started shakingly.
The two of them touched each other from time to time. Liu Yanran was ashamed and angry, but she was also glad that she didn't wear shorts today. Otherwise, she really didn't know how she would survive this long journey...
It was quite hot in the car.
There were at least seven or eight pairs of eyes all around, staring at her eagerly. Liu Yanran was very afraid that these men would pounce on her next moment and eat her alive.
On the other hand, the boy next to him had been reading with his head down, without any excessive behavior.
This surprised Liu Yanran. Could it be that he wasn't interested in her?
